FINAL IVX GLOBAL BRAND STANDARDIZATION, provide top Quality height logo end to end 
USE THE ATTACHED IVX LOGO AS THE ONLY OFFICIAL BRAND LOGO END TO END

EXECUTE NOW — DO NOT RETURN ONLY A PLAN

The attached IVX logo is now the official and permanent IVX Holdings brand mark.

From today forward, every IVX product, screen, website, application, document, card, email, social asset, and business surface must use this same logo system.

Do not continue using different IVX logos, temporary icons, crowns, text-only logos, Rork logos, placeholders, generated symbols, or inconsistent branding.

==================================================
OFFICIAL BRAND SOURCE
==================================================

Use the attached image as the primary source of truth.

Official characteristics:

- Black background
- Gold architectural IVX symbol
- Gold “IVX” lettering
- Premium luxury real-estate appearance
- Minimalist enterprise presentation
- No alternate symbol unless derived directly from this same logo
- No color changes without owner approval
- No redesign without owner approval

Store the master asset inside the owner-controlled IVX repository.

Suggested canonical assets:

assets/brand/ivx-logo-master.png
assets/brand/ivx-logo-horizontal.png
assets/brand/ivx-logo-stacked.png
assets/brand/ivx-symbol.png
assets/brand/ivx-wordmark.png
assets/brand/ivx-logo-light.png
assets/brand/ivx-logo-dark.png
assets/brand/ivx-app-icon.png
assets/brand/ivx-favicon.png
assets/brand/ivx-splash-logo.png
assets/brand/ivx-social-profile.png
assets/brand/ivx-email-logo.png
assets/brand/ivx-business-card-logo.png

Do not create unrelated logos.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — BRAND ASSET PREPARATION
==================================================

From the attached logo, prepare production-ready variants while preserving the same design:

1. Master high-resolution PNG.
2. Transparent-background version.
3. Black-background version.
4. Gold-on-black version.
5. Gold symbol-only version.
6. Horizontal layout.
7. Stacked layout.
8. Square app-icon layout.
9. Favicon sizes.
10. Android adaptive icon foreground.
11. Android legacy icon.
12. iOS app icon set.
13. Expo splash asset.
14. Website header version.
15. Website footer version.
16. Email signature version.
17. Business-card version.
18. Social-media profile version.
19. Social-media cover version.
20. Monochrome fallback.

Do not stretch, crop, distort, recolor, add shadows, add gradients, or alter the proportions without approval.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — REMOVE ALL OLD OR CONFLICTING LOGOS
==================================================

Search the complete repository and deployed assets for:

- old IVX logos
- crown icons used as the main logo
- text-only IVX headers
- Rork branding
- placeholder logos
- generic building icons
- temporary initials
- inconsistent gold colors
- duplicate logos
- old favicons
- old app icons
- old splash assets
- old social icons
- logo URLs hosted outside owner-controlled storage

For every match:

- identify file;
- identify screen/module;
- identify runtime usage;
- replace with the official IVX asset;
- remove obsolete assets when safe;
- preserve historical files only when clearly archived.

Return the full before/after inventory.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — MOBILE APP BRANDING
==================================================

Apply the official IVX logo consistently across the Expo React Native application.

Required locations:

- app icon
- Android launcher icon
- Android adaptive icon
- iOS app icon
- splash screen
- loading screen
- login screen
- owner login
- member login
- registration
- password recovery
- home header
- navigation drawer
- bottom navigation where appropriate
- profile
- settings
- owner dashboard
- Admin Hub
- IVX IA Chat
- Autonomous Dashboard
- Executive Layer
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- CRM
- Properties
- Deals
- Portfolio
- Wallet
- Reels
- Notifications
- Documents
- Variables
- Reports
- error screens
- offline screens
- maintenance screens
- update screens
- APK install branding

Do not place the full logo repeatedly where it hurts usability.

Use:

- full logo for login, splash, major headers, and brand moments;
- symbol-only version for compact headers, tab icons, avatars, and small spaces.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — LANDING PAGE AND WEBSITE
==================================================

Apply the same official IVX logo to:

- ivxholding.com
- chat.ivxholding.com
- owner dashboard
- admin dashboard
- public landing page
- investor pages
- buyer pages
- property pages
- deal pages
- member registration
- waitlist
- footer
- navigation
- favicon
- browser metadata
- Open Graph image
- social preview image
- login pages
- error pages
- 404 page
- maintenance page
- privacy page
- terms page
- contact page

The website and mobile app must clearly look like one IVX enterprise platform.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — IVX IA CHAT BRANDING
==================================================

Replace inconsistent chat branding.

IVX IA Chat must use:

- official IVX symbol in the header;
- official IVX logo in the entry screen;
- official IVX favicon;
- official IVX loading state;
- official IVX empty state;
- official IVX error state;
- official IVX assistant avatar derived from the same symbol;
- official IVX branding in task evidence cards;
- no Rork logo;
- no unrelated crown as the primary brand;
- no different AI logo.

The assistant may be labeled:

IVX IA
IVX Owner AI
IVX Senior Developer

But the visual identity must remain the same official IVX logo system.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — BUSINESS AND DOCUMENT BRANDING
==================================================

Apply the official logo to:

- business cards
- investor presentations
- proposals
- contracts
- invoices
- receipts
- property reports
- deal-room documents
- capital-pipeline reports
- executive reports
- certification reports
- email signatures
- letterheads
- PDF exports
- social-media posts
- Instagram profile
- TikTok profile
- LinkedIn profile
- YouTube profile
- marketing materials
- construction signs
- real-estate signs
- QR-code cards
- investor welcome packs

Create reusable document templates using the same logo, typography, and gold/black palette.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — CENTRAL BRAND COMPONENT
==================================================

Create one reusable brand component instead of copying logo code everywhere.

Example:

IVXBrandLogo

Supported variants:

- full
- symbol
- wordmark
- horizontal
- stacked
- light-background
- dark-background
- compact

Supported sizes:

- xs
- sm
- md
- lg
- xl
- hero

Required behavior:

- correct aspect ratio;
- accessible label;
- no distortion;
- no remote dependency;
- local cached asset;
- consistent spacing;
- dark/light compatibility;
- test coverage.

All screens must import this central component.

Do not hardcode separate logo implementations across modules.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — DESIGN TOKENS
==================================================

Create one central IVX brand-token source.

Define:

- primary black
- official gold
- secondary gold
- text white
- muted gray
- error red
- success green
- background surfaces
- border colors
- logo spacing
- logo minimum size
- corner radius
- typography
- icon style

Do not invent different gold colors screen by screen.

Use the same approved brand tokens across:

- mobile
- web
- emails
- PDFs
- dashboards
- social templates

==================================================
PHASE 9 — BRAND GOVERNANCE
==================================================

Add brand rules:

1. This attached logo is the official master.
2. No team or agent may create a replacement logo automatically.
3. No AI agent may redesign the brand without owner approval.
4. No Rork branding may appear in production.
5. No old logo may remain active.
6. No inconsistent gold colors.
7. No stretched or low-resolution versions.
8. No external hot-linked logo assets.
9. All logo changes require owner approval.
10. All new apps created by the IVX Factory must inherit the IVX brand system unless explicitly created as an independent brand.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — APP FACTORY BRAND INHERITANCE
==================================================

Update the IVX Factory so every new IVX-owned application can automatically receive:

- official IVX logo;
- app icon;
- splash screen;
- favicon;
- color tokens;
- typography;
- navigation branding;
- email templates;
- PDF templates;
- business-card template;
- social assets.

For independent applications:

- do not automatically use the IVX logo unless the owner approves;
- store each independent brand in its own isolated brand package.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — QA EVERY SCREEN
==================================================

Audit every route and screen.

For each screen verify:

- correct logo;
- correct variant;
- correct size;
- correct alignment;
- correct contrast;
- no stretching;
- no clipping;
- no pixelation;
- no duplicate brand marks;
- no old logo;
- no Rork branding;
- no placeholder;
- works on Android;
- works on iOS;
- works on web;
- works in light/dark conditions where applicable;
- accessible label exists.

Test:

- small phones
- large phones
- tablets
- desktop web
- portrait
- landscape
- low-resolution devices
- high-density screens

==================================================
PHASE 12 — BUILD AND DEPLOY
==================================================

After brand replacement:

1. Run repository-wide search for old logos.
2. Run frontend tests.
3. Run typecheck.
4. Run lint.
5. Build web.
6. Build Android APK.
7. Build Android AAB.
8. Prepare iOS icon/splash set.
9. Deploy website.
10. Deploy backend only if asset/API changes require it.
11. Upload new branded APK after owner approval.
12. Verify live pages and installed app.

Owner approval required for:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY
CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD

==================================================
PHASE 13 — REQUIRED LIVE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Provide screenshots from:

- landing page
- mobile splash
- mobile login
- home
- IVX IA Chat
- owner dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Members
- Investors
- Deals
- Portfolio
- Reels
- Settings
- error screen
- business card
- email signature
- PDF report
- website favicon/browser tab

All must show the same IVX brand family.

==================================================
PHASE 14 — REQUIRED EVIDENCE
==================================================

Return:

MASTER ASSET:
Path:
Dimensions:
Format:
Checksum:

ASSET VARIANTS:
List every generated file.

OLD BRAND AUDIT:
Old logos found:
Old logos removed:
Old logos retained:
Reason retained:

SCREENS UPDATED:

List:

List:

Commands:
Passed:
Failed:
Skipped:

BUILD:

iOS assets:

DEPLOYMENT:
GitHub SHA:
Render deploy ID:
Runtime SHA:
Website deployment:
APK URL:
Version:
Version code:
SHA-256:

LIVE QA:
Android:
iOS:
Web:

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
==================================================

Do not mark complete until:

[ ] The attached logo is stored as the canonical master.
[ ] All active old logos are removed.
[ ] No Rork logo remains.
[ ] App icon uses the official IVX symbol.
[ ] Splash screen uses the official IVX logo.
[ ] Landing page uses the official IVX logo.
[ ] IVX IA Chat uses the official IVX logo.
[ ] Every owner/admin module uses the same brand system.
[ ] Business cards use the official logo.
[ ] Emails and documents use the official logo.
[ ] Favicon and social previews are updated.
[ ] All screens use the central brand component.
[ ] All colors use central tokens.
[ ] Android, iOS, and web branding match.
[ ] No stretched, blurry, clipped, or inconsistent logo exists.
[ ] New IVX Factory apps inherit the official brand system.
[ ] Build and deployment pass.
[ ] Live screenshots prove consistency.

FINAL STATUS:

IVX GLOBAL BRAND STANDARDIZATION — COMPLETE AND VERIFIED

or

PARTIAL — LIST EVERY SCREEN OR ASSET STILL USING AN OLD OR INCONSISTENT LOGO

This logo represents the IVX business.

From today forward, it is the only official IVX Holdings logo for the main IVX platform.
